fastboot.mjs is fastboot.js by Danny Lin (kdrag0n), release v1.1.3, unmodified.

  upstream  https://github.com/kdrag0n/fastboot.js (tag v1.1.3)
  taken as  dist/fastboot.mjs from the npm package android-fastboot@1.1.3
            https://registry.npmjs.org/android-fastboot/-/android-fastboot-1.1.3.tgz
  sha256    75460db5bd89d4929df3858848ad634f19a23fb5fad5dd2bf8fbe63847d5b3b5
  licence   MIT, see LICENSE.fastboot.js.txt

The bundle contains zip.js 2.2.27 (BSD-3-Clause, with its own embedded
deflate, inflate and AES code). Their copyright and licence notices are kept
inside fastboot.mjs, which is why the unminified build is used. The installer
does not call the zip code.

To update: replace fastboot.mjs and the licence file from a newer release,
update the version and checksum here, and test both flashing phases.
